items.item: Anchors progression in the specific fantasy (cooking, customers, the city) rather than generic numbers
Progression changes what the player can do or understand, not only stat multipliers
Does not default to pets/eggs/rebirths/generic currencies without justification (or explicitly challenges them)
Considers onboarding and the first minutes of play
Considers economy sources and sinks if a currency is proposed
Proposes how to test/validate with players rather than claiming it will be fun

slop: Franchise prestige reset with permanent % bonuses (rebirth loop) without fantasy justification
Four currencies including Robux-purchasable premium Neon Tokens
Pets sold as cosmetics in a ramen-stand game
Daily contracts, login streak, ~40 achievements as generic retention scaffolding
Exponential base×1.6^level upgrade lines that are mostly stat increases (+speed, +patience, +walk-ins)
Mars Colony / new-city prestige content disconnected from the night-shift stand fantasy
Claim 'every run is faster so it stays fun instead of grindy' asserted without evidence
overengineering: Four currencies plus a separate Rep tier spine, crew system, franchise, and shift modifiers all at once
Second stand slot and drone delivery widen scope beyond a small stand

raw.reason: A ties progression to verbs, regulars and the stand, explicitly rejects rebirths and extra currencies with reasons, and covers sinks, onboarding and testable hypotheses; B mostly reuses simulator defaults like prestige, premium currency, pets and 2x gamepasses.
